text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: `private-vpc-agent-silent` for customer=FinGrid (severity=P1). Large set of agents stopped heartbeating, control-plane returns 504s for config fetch.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident #PD-98210 created and routed to oncall. https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-98210
Maya Chen: acked in PD, taking first touch. Oncall here. :hand:
Maya Chen: from alert: ~60 agents across 4 clusters in customer's VPC haven't heartbeated in ~7m, controlplane API 504s on agent sync.
Priya Rao: pinging CS. @cs-rep please confirm what FinGrid's side shows.
cs-rep: FinGrid-ops reports their service proxies are failing with 504 gateway timeout when calling our control-plane endpoints. They see no network change on their side yet.
Maya Chen: triage plan: (1) confirm controlplane pod logs, (2) check agent_store for last_heartbeat, (3) trace network path to agent IPs, (4) engage customer infra.
Ravi Singh: commands for customer's kubecontext `fg-prod-ctrl`:
```
kubectl --context=fg-prod-ctrl get pods -n redwood-controlplane -o wide
kubectl --context=fg-prod-ctrl logs deployment/controlplane-api -n redwood-controlplane --since=15m | tail -n 200
```
Maya Chen: controlplane-api logs show repeated `net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)` when contacting agents; dial attempts to 10.250.30.11:8443 time out.
Maya Chen: DB check:
```
SELECT agent_id, node_ip, last_heartbeat FROM agent_store WHERE last_heartbeat < now() - interval '60 seconds' LIMIT 200;
```
Maya Chen: result ~62 agents, last_heartbeat 8-25m ago across 4 AZs. Pattern: sudden egress block from controlplane to private agent subnets or agent-side NAT issue.
Jorge Silva: can you tcpdump on controlplane host to agent IP 10.250.30.11? traceroute as well. Might be firewall or route change.
Maya Chen: running tcpdump:
```
sudo tcpdump -nni eth0 host 10.250.30.11 and port 8443 -c 200 -w /tmp/fg-ctlp-3702.pcap
```
Maya Chen: tcpdump capture shows SYNs leaving but no SYN-ACKs returned. traceroute to 10.250.30.11 stops at 10.250.0.1 (VPC gateway).
Alex Morgan: tagging cloud-network and peering. @FinGrid-ops any recent firewall/NAT/route changes in your VPC?
FinGrid-ops: we changed a host-based firewall policy on the subnet this morning as part of a security rollout. We rolled back the change an hour ago but didn't see problems until now. We'll re-check.
Priya Rao: CS please get the specific change detail and whether the rule blocks TCP/8443 egress or ingress.
cs-rep: forwarding policy snippet from FinGrid: `ufw` rule added to drop unsolicited inbound connections from unknown CIDRs; they suspect it might have blocked our controlplane replies due to asymmetric NAT.
Maya Chen: hypothesis: host firewall change causing asymmetric routing where controlplane SYN reaches agent but agent replies are dropped because reverse path doesn't match new firewall expectations. Need to confirm packet captures on agent side.
Maya Chen: ask FinGrid to run tcpdump on agent host for port 8443 during known heartbeat window. Provide command snippet.
Maya Chen: sent to FinGrid-ops:
```
sudo tcpdump -nni eth0 port 8443 -w /tmp/agent-8443.pcap -c 200
sudo tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood-agent.log | grep -i handshake
```
FinGrid-ops: running and attaching pcap. They report: agent shows SYN-ACKs not seen from our controlplane source IPs; agent logs show repeated connection resets and `tls: remote error: handshake failure`.
Jorge Silva: that indicates replies from agent host to controlplane are not reaching our controlplane nodes. Could be outbound firewall blocking ephemeral ports or incorrect SNAT. Ask FinGrid to temporarily allow all traffic to/from controlplane IP ranges for test.
FinGrid-ops: we can open a temporary rule to allow 10.240.0.0/12 (our controlplane subnet) to agent subnet on tcp/8443 for 15 minutes. Doing it now.
FinGrid-ops: rule applied at 11:18 UTC.
Maya Chen: retesting connectivity: traceroute now reaches agent IP fully, tcpdump shows SYN-SYN/ACK handshake, and agent heartbeats start coming back. Querying DB...
Maya Chen: re-run agent_store query: stale agents reduced from ~62 to ~10; most heartbeats within last 40s. Controlplane 5xx rate dropping to baseline.
Priya Rao: CS update sent to FinGrid: "We've observed controlplane replies were being dropped by your host firewall rules. Thanks for applying temporary allow rule; please confirm if you'll make a permanent exception or if you want us to use fallback relay."
FinGrid-ops: we'll make a permanent rule to allow Redwood controlplane subnets and will audit our host firewall automation to avoid reintroducing block. We'll coordinate maintenance window for rollout.
Amir Patel: PD escalation: keep severity P1 until post-incident task done (permanent rule in place). Page network lead to verify nothing else affected.
pagerduty-bot: PD-98210 escalated to network-lead@redwood and oncall-sre@redwood
Maya Chen: mitigation recap: temporary firewall allow rule applied by customer, controlplane retries smoothed by increasing agent retry window earlier (we applied small config tweak):
```
REDWOOD_AGENT_RETRY_INTERVAL=10s
REDWOOD_AGENT_MAX_RETRIES=10
```
Maya Chen: rollouts of those env tweaks applied to controlplane as rolling update to reduce 504s during rollback windows.
Alex Morgan: confirm with FinGrid that firewall automation won't reapply blocking rule. Also request their firewall audit logs.
FinGrid-ops: automation team identified the offending rule generator; they will patch the script to whitelist our controlplane CIDRs and stop blocking established ephemeral ports. Target ETA for full fix: 6 hours.
Maya Chen: post-incident actions: (1) document firewall whitelist guidance in private-VPC runbook (include ephemeral port ranges and controlplane CIDRs), (2) add an onboarding checklist to collect customer firewall automation contacts, (3) create an automated preflight that checks reachability of our controlplane subnets from customer agent subnets before applying host-firewall rollouts, (4) store packet captures and logs in PD-98210 artifacts.
Priya Rao: CS to coordinate a technical postmortem with FinGrid and schedule the maintenance window for permanent rule.
cs-rep: message sent to FinGrid-ops with the runbook link and preflight checklist.
Maya Chen: handoff: I'll remain primary for 30 minutes to ensure no regressions. If stable, move PD to monitoring and Amir will take watch.
Amir Patel: ack, I'll monitor for 30 minutes. :eyes:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-98210 status changed to "monitoring" by Maya Chen
Maya Chen: locking this Slack thread for now. Thanks team and FinGrid for quick response. :heart:
